item.title: SHUT IT DOWN, GET ICE OUT! Nationwide General Strike January 30th
item.description: Following Minnesota's massively successful general strike, unions across the nation are calling for a nationwide general strike this Friday, January 30th. As ICE continues to terrorize our communities, the time to stand up and fight back is here. No politician is going to save us. Only we can save us. The post SHUT IT DOWN, GET ICE OUT! Nationwide General Strike January 30th appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.

item.title: KCPD Holds Taxpayers Hostage While Shielding a Killer in Blue

item.title: Independence Residents Fight a $6.6 Billion Data Center as Monday’s Tax Break Vote Looms
item.description: Independence is the latest front in a nationwide battle over data centers. On Monday, the city council will vote on whether to hand billions in tax breaks to a Dutch tech company for a project that, at full scale, will consume 18 times more electricity than every home in the city combined. Residents say they were never consulted. The post Independence Residents Fight a $6.6 Billion Data Center as Monday’s Tax Break Vote Looms appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.

item.description: From Kenya's fire sale of Safaricom to skyrocketing utility bills in Black neighborhoods across America, privatization is reversing the gains of liberation movements worldwide. The second installment of Jon Jeter's Plunder Papers. item.title: Who the Terrorists Are: On the American-Israeli War in Iran
item.description: They killed 165 schoolgirls on a Saturday morning, bragged about obtaining "complete control of Iranian skies," and plunged the planet into its most dangerous military crisis since 1945. A radical examination of American empire's suicidal hubris, the intelligence operations that manufactured the pretext, and the media apparatus selling civilizational destruction as foreign policy. The post Who the Terrorists Are: On the American-Israeli War in Iran appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.
